name: Channeled Ray (General)
body:
You have learned to shape the divine energies of your channeling, unleashing them, if you desire, as a ray instead of a burst.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature, Channeled Cone.

Benefit(s): You can, when you channel energy, unleash the energy as a ray instead of a burst. The ray begins from the point of your divine focus and extends to a length equal to three times the radius of your channeling range, with a width of five feet.
